input.description: See features.py: piece planes of the last history_length positions (newest first, zero planes before the start of the game), the player plane (0 attackers, 1 defenders), then the optional constant, reach and king-region planes. All values are 0 or 1.

policy.index: from_square * 4 * (N-1) + direction * (N-1) + (distance - 1), with from_square = row * N + col and directions 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right
policy.note: logits; take the softmax over the legal moves only

value: tanh output in [-1, 1] for the player to move
